variable_naming: All candidate switches are proposed experiment names, not claims of pre-existing config keys. Raw source locations and units are specified per variable.
run_order: E01–E03 address mirror/overlap counterplay; E04–E06 address cross-pair commitment and Steam reliability. Run each against its own frozen baseline; combine only accepted diffs with an additional full regression.

source_freeze.baseline: Freeze the locally runnable equivalent of this source; never assume the live checkout is still identical. Save a separate baseline result and exact diff for each experiment.

invariants: 120 Hz authority; fixed integer world units and same source-ID ordering
All eight elements, 36 recipe IDs, enabled ability catalog and 12 configurable slots retained
Whole selected hexes; no actor circle re-clipping or nearest-N truncation
600 paid matter per source, existing strength subtraction, immutable paid source IDs, one-use modifier channels
Existing capacities and capacity-before-payment; no invisible paid-product eviction or free refresh
Current body templates, 18 px common wall clearance, movement costs/cooldowns, teams and protection unchanged except expressly named candidate behavior

measurement_protocol.equal_demand: Replay identical press/release/held commands, all eight actors alive where the fixture requires it, with all later-four features enabled. Also rerun the original 480-tick fixture for comparability. Human movement-dependent outcomes are recorded separately, not used as a cheaper performance replay.
report: source identity, candidate variables and hardware/engine identity
input press edges, held ticks, eligible release opportunities, authority requested/admitted/refused and reasons; do not equate those denominators
active-cell peak and instance-ticks; product/cast/projectile peaks and instance-ticks
candidate contact/contribution counts as well as applied effects and deaths
paid/live/consumed/expired matter and consumed-source IDs, no free product clones
simulation p50/p95/p99/max; capture+wire-pack p50/p95/p99/max; total host work and deadline misses
event type and semantic class; produced/accepted/retained/evicted/unencodable counts; snapshot raw/packed bytes, wire bytes, fragments, queue high water
normal/reduced native-scale recognition and escape outcomes separated by body size
measurement_protocol.historical_reference: PROFILE#/runs/0 records accounting success but timing failure. Report old and new results side by side; never copy old successful functional results into new candidate results.

gates.G0: All applicable deterministic predicates in COUNTERPLAY_TESTS.md pass, including later-four, conservation, ordering and protection. Zero new unexplained divergence, paid loss, unencodable authoritative event, or lifecycle failure.
gates.G1: Paired demand/admission ledgers are comparable. Any intentional geometry or applied-event reduction is disclosed and traced to the candidate, not hidden via refusals, disabled products, lower tick rate, validation removal or eviction.
gates.G2: Diagnostic no-regression gate: across each of the three paired seeds, candidate simulation/capture/host p95 <= baseline x1.05 and p99 <= baseline x1.10 at equal documented demand; no increase in unclassified event loss or admission failures. This does NOT clear the known production performance failure.
gates.G3: Promotion separately requires the integrator's complete Full, localhost return/rematch and actual render/network acceptance. For this proposal the authority/host 120 Hz deadline remains 8333 microseconds; a candidate slower than it is not a performance pass even if G2 passes.
gates.G4: Human readings are recorded as trials, not anecdotes: at least 12 counterbalanced opportunities per relevant condition, rotate size and player role; >=10/12 correct phase/direction/counter choices for the named drill target. This is a local readability gate, not a population win-rate claim.

shared_controls.rollback_protocol: Keep a separate local commit/diff owned by the integrator for each candidate. Stop only owned test processes; restore only that candidate's edited hunks/switches and rerun its focused baseline. Do not reset/stash/clean shared dirty work, mass-edit catalogs, push or promote a checkpoint. A later experiment does not silently depend on an earlier one being accepted.

experiments.title: Vortex: create a real whole-hex eye
experiments.hypothesis: A geometrically real center opening gives a grounded route-planning counter and a useful ring to play around without reducing force or expanding outer coverage.

baseline.finding: No complete authored hex fits inside the 30000-unit inner circle; baseline selection fills the eye.

candidate_variables.name: vortex_inner_radius
candidate_variables.units: world units (1000 per pixel); raw compiled length 24000 -> 59200 under unchanged x1.25 extent
candidate_variables.proposed_live_location: hex_recipe_policy.gd: wire 322 COMPILED_ROWS length field only

setup: At an unobstructed grid center, shared face, shared vertex and each position ±1 world unit, form Vortex using valid paid pairs. Repeat in negative axial coordinates and adjacent to a wall.
Hold outer radius 90000, flow 45000, timing 48/330/48 and all phase/quantity code fixed. Do not manually delete a chosen hex: let unchanged positive-area annulus selection operate.
Use the baseline source freeze, not an already modified flow or presenter build. Test all three body templates with the same foot trace before using natural movement.

measured_outcomes.metric: center-owning cell selected (boolean)
center safe-cell count and selected-cell IDs
grounded entry/exit success and wall entrapment ticks
active-cell peak/instance-ticks; unchanged initial transferred matter
normal/reduced recognition of affected boundary and opening

acceptance_criteria: Every unobstructed tested center-owning cell is excluded by selection; every selected annular cell remains fully authoritative, including its interior outside the analytic band.
At least one valid ground escape path exists in each intentionally open fixture; no new clipping, collision escape exploit or all-size disagreement is introduced.
Force, product quantity and phase times are unchanged; selected-cell count never exceeds baseline for identical center/topology; >0 affected cells remain in the open fixtures.
H01: at least 10/12 trials identify the real safe opening, and grounded passage succeeds whenever the scripted path lies in excluded cells.
Pass G0, G1 and G2; apply G4 to the named human question. G3 remains a separate release block.
rollback_criteria: Any tested center still affects its whole owner cell, outer reach grows, inner band is rendered safe while selected, or narrow fixtures become unreadable/trapping.
The reduced ring no longer offers a usable rotational interception route in H01; retain the finding but reject the numeric candidate rather than inflating outer radius.
Any shared correctness, conservation, later-four compatibility, event-integrity or performance no-regression gate fails.

experiments.title: Conflagration: preserve a readable pulse gap under overlap
experiments.hypothesis: A single globally phased strongest Conflagration dose makes overlap deny a place rather than manufacture near-continuous damage by phase-staggering many otherwise identical paid fields.

baseline.overlap_damage: sum of independently due eligible products

candidate_variables.name: conflagration_pulse_clock
candidate_variables.units: clock policy; period remains 72 ticks (600 ms)

candidate_variables.name: conflagration_overlap_damage
candidate_variables.units: aggregation policy; ties lowest stable product ID; maximum selection only within wire 309
candidate_variables.proposed_live_location: hex_chemistry_world.gd: collect wire 309 contributors then resolve one winner

setup: Use one, two and eight distinct paid Conflagrations, equal and unequal strengths, with creation offsets 0, 1, 35 and 71 ticks and shared eligible feet.
An eligible product must satisfy active_tick <= tick < min(decay_tick, expiry_tick). On tick %72==0 choose maximum integer damage, tie lowest product ID, then use existing damage/defeat handling.
Do not fold fundamental Fire, Steam, Magma or Firestorm into this group. Do not remove losing products, refund their sources, or change coverage and quantity.
Document that a solitary product can wait 0–71 ticks after activation for its first global pulse; this timing tradeoff is intentional and is not baseline-equivalent.

measured_outcomes.metric: damage event ticks and contributor IDs per actor
damage and winner identity on coincident pulses
first-active-to-first-pulse delay ticks
maximum consecutive ground danger without a scheduled gap
H03 correct crossing timing and completion; active-cell/event/snapshot costs

acceptance_criteria: At most one wire-309 damage application per eligible actor per global pulse; damage equals strongest eligible candidate, never the sum.
Owner/allies retain the same baseline vulnerability; no active-before-formation hit, post-decay hit or duplicated defeat event.

Within each product lifetime the candidate never exceeds the damage from all baseline-eligible products for a continuously grounded stationary actor; record phase-dependent crossing outcomes separately.
H03: >=10/12 counter opportunities correctly use or avoid the public pulse phase; attackers can still deny a selected ground landing window in >=10/12 scripted on-pulse landings.
Pass G0, G1 and G2; apply G4 to the named human question. G3 remains a separate release block.
rollback_criteria: The new phase cannot be read from the existing source-driven presentation in normal/reduced mode, or the delayed first pulse makes the paid field a misleading harmless-looking trap.
Any field is silently removed or paid stock refunded to compensate for a losing contribution; any global damage/target-team behavior outside wire 309 changes.

experiments.title: Ground-flow overlap: one bounded net displacement
experiments.hypothesis: Combining already-eligible first-four ground-flow contributions before collision limits same-cell wall pins and cancellation artifacts while preserving a single field's useful directional role.

baseline.baseline_aggregation: per-product integer carry, sequential per-product collision moves

candidate_variables.name: first_four_ground_flow_overlap
candidate_variables.proposed_live_location: hex_product_effects.gd / hex_chemistry_world.gd: shared collection before actor displacement

candidate_variables.name: first_four_ground_flow_net_cap
candidate_variables.units: world units/second; <=502 units displacement per 120 Hz tick before collision, including a conservative fixed-point rounding allowance
candidate_variables.proposed_live_location: shared first-four flow application; derived per-tick cap

setup: Preserve existing per-product fractional carries and stable contributor order. Compute every direction from the common pre-push actor position; do not let an earlier impulse change a later Vortex tangent.

Sum the integer per-product deltas of all already-eligible first-four flow fields. Clamp the vector to length <=502 world units using integer square root rounded upward for the divisor, component division toward zero, then make one collision move at the unchanged 18000-unit clearance.

The discrete cap is ceil(60000/120)+2 = 502 units/tick: a conservative fixed-point rounding allowance, not an increase to any individual flow speed. For example an unchanged 60px/s Flood at aim(707,707) can alternate (353,353) and (354,354), so a strict 500-unit norm clamp would incorrectly alter the isolated baseline.
Do not bank clipped excess for later bursts; the cap discards excess requested displacement, not ingredient matter. Preserve every contributor, paid product and suppression capacity.
Test one, two and eight sources with parallel, opposing and perpendicular directions; wall corners; all body sizes; slides and jumps. Do not change later-four movement/control logic.

Require a bounded, version-owned flow event containing contributor IDs/requested deltas and applied net delta if the old event schema cannot represent the new semantics. Do not fabricate per-product applied displacements.

measured_outcomes.metric: requested vector versus applied vector world units/tick
max net displacement and available jump/wall action response ticks
same-foot-trace displacement by body size
contributor count, event encoding size, snapshot state and active-cell work
wall pin duration and successful H01/H07 exit actions

acceptance_criteria: Isolated-field open-space output and carry match baseline exactly; aggregate norm never exceeds 502 units per tick.
Equal opposite requested deltas cancel before collision; no false inward move survives solely because product IDs changed the collision sequence.
All available jump/escape commands remain accepted on the same eligibility tick as the matched isolated-control fixture; no new actor-state lock, wall penetration or accumulated release burst.
No change to later-four pre-movement or control-state behavior; every contributor remains traceable, and no authoritative flow event becomes unencodable.
Pass G0, G1 and G2; apply G4 to the named human question. G3 remains a separate release block.
rollback_criteria: Single-field output changes, net cap is exceeded by rounding, carry grows without bound, or the aggregate event cannot be delivered within existing bounded envelopes.
H01/H07 show a loss of usable directional play or a new reliable pin in a fixture that had a valid escape; do not compensate by enlarging fields or deleting contributors.
Any shared correctness, conservation, later-four compatibility, event-integrity or performance no-regression gate fails.

cost_implications.cpu: Replaces repeated collision moves with collection + one move per affected actor, but collection/normalization cost must be measured, not assumed faster.

experiments.title: Magma: require strength commitment for full pulse payoff
experiments.hypothesis: Scaling only Magma's fixed pulse down for weak matched strength may prevent low-commitment delivery from buying full-strength damage while preserving Magma's slow, moving ground-route role.

candidate_variables.name: magma_pulse_strength_scaling
candidate_variables.units: health units per eligible 48-tick pulse; strength 1/3/5/15 -> 500/1500/2500/5000

setup: First resolve and freeze the live ability catalog: actual Flux, repeat intervals, recovery, damage/control and movement resource costs. If unavailable, keep this experiment NOT_RUN rather than guessing cost efficiency.

Use pristine and partially consumed sources from all four families; keep actual paid costs unchanged. Compare equal paid Flux over a fixed command window as well as equal admitted pair count, reporting both.
Do not scale slow, selected reach, lifetime, front speed, Firestorm damage, Rampart health or Mistcurrent capacity. Heavy gains no additional pulse damage.
Run straight-ground, sliding-ground, airborne and lateral-detour paths. Sliding bypasses the ordinary target-speed modifier, not grounded Magma damage.

measured_outcomes.metric: pulse damage by matched strength and remaining quantity
enemy damage/route-denial time per actual paid Flux and per admitted pair
retained jump/slide/side-exit outcomes
family usage/commitment choices in H04, without claiming statistical market balance
peak cells, contacts, events, admissions and packed bytes

acceptance_criteria: Formula matches exactly, capped at baseline 5000; no damage above baseline for any intensity and no change in slow or effect lifetime.
H04 participants identify the ground-only jump/detour counter in >=10/12 opportunities and full-commitment Magma still punishes >=10/12 scripted grounded on-pulse crossings.

The suspected weak-family advantage must be demonstrated in the actual baseline cost table and then reduced by the candidate; if the baseline does not show the problem, do not adopt a speculative nerf.
At least two delivery families retain a distinct useful Magma setup in the recorded drills; report utility loss rather than inventing a win-rate target.
Pass G0, G1 and G2; apply G4 to the named human question. G3 remains a separate release block.
rollback_criteria: The source-equalization hypothesis is unsupported by actual paid-cost/cadence measurements, or weaker Magma becomes a useless imitation of Mud/Firestorm.
Any change affects other recipes, makes slide damage disappear, increases Heavy damage, or hides reduced actual workload behind fewer surviving actors.

experiments.title: Steam: make paid cooling a reliable counter, not extra scald
experiments.hypothesis: Spending Water as cooling work instead of extra scald density makes the cooling channel monotonically reduce that product's equal-exposure pressure; excluding decay-only targets prevents a fading product from wasting the paid counter.

baseline.heat_behavior: unchanged: add remaining matter, add 50*S capped1500, halve remaining lifetime

candidate_variables.name: steam_cooling_quantity_destination
candidate_variables.units: ledger accounting policy; incoming finite matter is still consumed, but cooling adds 0 live product matter
candidate_variables.proposed_live_location: hex_chemistry_world.gd: _try_modifier cooling branch; keep heat transfer unchanged

candidate_variables.name: steam_modifier_phase_eligibility
candidate_variables.units: tick predicate; forming and active accepted, harmless decay rejected, applies to both one-use channels

setup: Preserve consume_remaining(), matter_consumed accounting, source_ids, one cooled/heated flag per channel and existing intensity rule. Cooling is a real paid effect; do not refund, drop the source, create fresh Water or decrement consumed accounting.

On cooling, leave product.quantity and its whole-cell allocations unchanged. Retile only as needed for unchanged coverage/metadata. The extra paid matter performs cooling work and is already represented as consumed in the ledger; it is not duplicated into another source.

On a decay-only candidate skip it and continue stable-ID search for another eligible product; if none accepts, let the same still-live paid source follow its existing normal terminal handling. Do not auto-create or refresh Steam.

Use single-factor diagnostic arms for the two named variables, then the combined candidate, with all other state identical. Report which factor affects each outcome; these are arms of E05, not additional unnamed changes.

Exhaustively compare each allocation and exposure E=0..240 before/after valid cooling at equal E, including intensity 100/300/500/1500, partially spent source quantities, zero-allocation cells and heat-then-cool/cool-then-heat sequences.

measured_outcomes.metric: per-product equal-exposure pressure before/after cooling, health units
paid/live/consumed/expired matter and product totals
modifier acceptance at active/decay/expiry boundaries and overlapping product ID
heat/cool channel uses, intensity and fixed coverage/expiry
H05 reliable paid counter recognition; active cells and event/replication cost

acceptance_criteria: For every tested cell/density/exposure, that product's immediate post-cooling pressure is <= its pre-cooling pressure at equal E; if baseline pressure was >0 and intensity falls enough to quantize a difference, record the actual reduction.

Reproduce the static counterexample through real Godot source creation before crediting a runtime fix: baseline 1075 ->1451 in the stated seven-cell equal-E fixture; candidate cooling-work arm yields 967 health units. If the live baseline differs, reconcile source/fixture first.

Every paid cooling source remains fully accounted as consumed work; product_total <= consumed and live+consumed+expired=paid. Heat behavior, initial pair transfer, geometry, caps and one-use channels are unchanged.

At decay_tick and later, the old Steam product consumes no incoming modifier; continued search/fallback keeps the source valid, finite and normally paid. At decay_tick-1 normal eligible behavior remains.

H05 >=10/12 opportunities identify leaving/exposure reset and demonstrate that fresh paid cooling does not make its own product more dangerous at equal exposure; a separately stronger Fire/Steam product may still win.
Pass G0, G1 and G2; apply G4 to the named human question. G3 remains a separate release block.
rollback_criteria: Any equal-E cooling case increases its own product's pressure, a consumed source gains new live matter, or an actor can refresh/reuse either channel for free.
A valid forming/active heat modifier changes compared with baseline, or rejection of fading Steam erases the incoming source instead of preserving normal handling.
Reduced intensity is mistaken for a universally safe field; keep damage/status tied to source and treat visual failure separately under E06.
Any shared correctness, conservation, later-four compatibility, event-integrity or performance no-regression gate fails.

experiments.title: Steam: style each source region by its actual intensity
experiments.hypothesis: Using per-region intensity removes the hard 1000 heat floor and prevents one hot overlapping product from relabeling cooler products, improving the recognition of paid thermal decisions without changing chemistry.

baseline.aggregation: max(1000, every Steam region intensity in the cell)
baseline.style_input: same aggregated heat passed to every Steam region
baseline.palette_rule: active: hot above1000, cool below1000, active at1000; forming/decay retain phase

candidate_variables.name: steam_style_intensity_source
candidate_variables.units: intensity units, ratio denominator1000; fallback1000 only when an invalid/missing field is diagnosed, not a minimum
candidate_variables.proposed_live_location: hex_court_presenter.gd: _draw_steam style and seed heat input

setup: Change only the heat argument/seed input within each Steam region iteration to the region's actual intensity. Do not edit authority view(), intensities, phases, cells, damage, opacity budgets or network state.

Freeze normal/reduced modes and light/dark floor fixtures at native scale. Test a solitary intensity500 product, a cooled product, an intensity1500 product and overlapping intensity500/1500 products in one cell.
Use actor, projectile and aim overlays in a runnable capture. Do not replace gameplay captures with concept images. Keep phase-derived danger outlines even for cool-colored active material.

Explain that cool palette means intensity <1000, not necessarily that someone used the cooling channel: unmodified Bolt/Bolt Steam starts at500. Test a participant can distinguish lower-intensity active scald from harmless expiry.

measured_outcomes.metric: chosen palette_phase and region intensity per footprint ID
normal/reduced phase recognition and actor/projectile/aim occlusion
authority state hash equality and event byte equality across visual modes
draw call/mark count and presenter CPU time; no particle count inflation

acceptance_criteria: For every active region, heat passed to style equals that region's intensity; <1000 selects cool, >1000 hot, ==1000 active. Forming/decay continue using their actual phases.
A hot overlapping region does not alter a cooler region's chosen palette phase; both retain correct whole-cell coverage and danger.
Authority hashes, source ledgers, damage events and replication bytes are identical between baseline and visual candidate for identical commands.

H05/H06 >=10/12 trials distinguish active lower-intensity scald from harmless decay in each normal/reduced floor condition; actors, projectiles and aim remain identifiable. Failure means no visual acceptance.
Pass G0, G1 and G2; apply G4 to the named human question. G3 remains a separate release block.
rollback_criteria: A palette change hides active danger, implies cool means harmless, changes simulation/network state, or requires more particles/marks to pass.
Layering still makes per-product intensity unreadable; report the remaining overlap limitation rather than claiming this one-line data-source change solves every visibility problem.
Any shared correctness, conservation, later-four compatibility, event-integrity or performance no-regression gate fails.
